::: {.obsidian-termination-letter}
:::

State the decision in the first paragraph. Name the date the
employment ends and the reason for the decision.

# Notice period

State the notice period served and whether the employee works it
or receives pay in lieu.

# Payments and benefits

State the final payments: salary to the last day, accrued holiday,
and any redundancy payment. Name the benefits that end and when.

# Return of property

List the property the employee must return: badge, laptop, phone,
and documents.

# Next steps

State the handover arrangements and the exit interview. Confirm
any post-employment restrictions that apply.
